failure.neo4j_error: Invalid input '"account_id"': expected an identifier or '}' at the first generated UNWIND map literal
failure.root_cause: The deterministic generator serialized Python mappings with JSON object syntax inside a Cypher UNWIND literal. JSON quotes map keys, whereas Neo4j 5.26 requires identifier keys in a Cypher map literal.

resolution.strategy: Encode the bounded generated values with a dedicated deterministic Cypher literal serializer that validates identifier-shaped map keys; keep JSON serialization only for JSON artifacts.
